methods.bottomhole: P_bh = P_res + q_ST / J at the declared common bottomhole datum.
methods.surface: P_wellhead = P_bh − gravity gain + friction loss; downward injection; no pressure clamping.
methods.fluid: Pinned gas-free NaCl brine evaluated at local pressure and prescribed temperature; straight TVD/MD slope and temperature linear over TVD. Reference-state properties are context only.
methods.friction: Existing RK4 step-doubling traverse; Darcy-Weisbach with retained Nexus Serghides Fanning factor ×4 to Darcy; custom transition interpolation.
methods.profile: Existing backend local depth nodes at the selected onstream rate. Unsupported solves retain null pressure outputs.
methods.curve: Existing caseHydraulicPoint evaluated on the explicit requested rate grid. Curves are screening points, not a capacity optimization.

provenance.inputs: User-entered assumptions; initial defaults are explicitly assumed fictional values.

inputOrigins.injectivityStbdPerPsi: Test-referenced J (estimate) from BHP test 2024-02-12 and H-10 2024-02; sealed estimate 726489b25fa4
inputOrigins.reservoirPsia: BHP test 2024-02-12: psig reading + 14.7 psi (basis confirmed: RRC Permian guidance: BHP reported in psig (verification))
inputOrigins.referencePressurePsia: Set to the reservoir pressure (fluid reference state, context only)
inputOrigins.datum: From the BHP test depth (RRC guidance: top of the completed disposal interval)
inputOrigins.tvdFt: BHP test depth; vertical well declared
inputOrigins.measuredDepthFt: BHP test depth; vertical well declared
inputOrigins.surfaceLimitPsia: Inventory permitted surface pressure 1500 psi + 14.7 psi (permit value)

pvt.reference: 45 fresh direct-library cases; 3 temperatures × 3 NaCl concentrations × 5 pressures; four properties checked
pvt.standardReference: 15 °C (59 °F), freshwater 0.1013 MPa; saline standard integral uses source 0.1015 MPa

validation.sourceAgreement: 45 recorded source-library cases; four properties checked.
validation.physicalAcceptance: Bounded physical screening only; full independent fluid-domain validation remains open.
validation.legacyNexusWaterFvf: Historical evidence only; incorrect retained Nexus water-FVF is excluded from live calculations.

wellboreFrictionSource.name: reference/nexus-wellbore/serghides.ts
wellboreFrictionSource.reuse: Owner-authorized local snapshot; source license not established; full Nexus injection/VFP parity not claimed

provenance.hydraulicsImplementation: Existing custom steady single-phase RK4 brine injection traverse and constant-J coupling.

pressureReferences.reservoir: Top of completed interval at 3310 ft TVD (RRC guidance), from BHP test 2024-02-12
pressureReferences.bottomholeLimit: Top of completed interval at 3310 ft TVD (RRC guidance), from BHP test 2024-02-12
pressureReferences.wellhead: Wellhead surface reference, 0 ft; related to the bottomhole datum by declared TVD.
pressureReferences.basis: All pressures absolute psia; no gauge conversion or inferred RRC pressure basis.
pressureReferences.handoffNote: Prefilled values were converted to psia by the J estimate as their origins state; this workspace itself applies no gauge conversion.

limitations: Gas-free NaCl brine only: methane saturation is zero; no dissolved CO2 or mixed-ion chemistry.
Application limits 100–10000 psia, 60–250 °F and 0–20 wt% are bounded demonstration limits, not a full correlation-domain validation.
Salinity is NaCl mass percent, not mg/L total dissolved solids; no automatic conversion from a measured TDS value.
Compressibility follows the source modified Spivey equation; it is not a numerical derivative of the IAPWS-adjusted density.
Exact source hashes identify the installed snapshot; package metadata alone does not establish an unmodified published release.
Assumed engineering screening only; no field calibration, sustainable-capacity acceptance or operating recommendation.
No demand allocation, capacity optimization, availability schedule, saved case or planning forecast is calculated in this workspace.
Straight geometry and prescribed temperature only; no heat transfer, fittings or pump model. Acceleration omitted; local velocity above 5 m/s is unsupported.

Reservoir and bottomhole pressure limit share the declared formation datum. Wellhead pressure is at the surface reference and is related through TVD; pressure values at different elevations are not interchangeable.
A zero rate is shut-in: the backend does not calculate a flowing pressure or local traverse.
Pressure below 100 psia, pressure-domain exits and declared limit exceedances remain explicitly flagged. Numerical solver failures block calculation.
